top_signals.title: COLDCARD wallet RNG flaw likely linked to $88 million Bitcoin theft
top_signals.summary: A vulnerability in COLDCARD hardware wallet firmware allowed attackers to steal an estimated $88.6 million in Bitcoin from thousands of wallets whose seeds were generated using a flawed random number generator. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. lawmakers request information from DoorDash on use of Chinese AI models
top_signals.summary: The food delivery company is the latest to be asked to share details of AI use by two House committee conducting a joint investigation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
